Title: Sort Assets by Function and Close Task
Description: Workflow to sort the Asset List by 'Asset function' and mark the associated task as complete.
- Navigate to the 'All Assets' view by selecting 'All' and typing 'All Assets' in the filter menu.
- Click the 'Show / hide filter' button to reveal sorting options.
- Click the 'Add Sort' button to configure a new sort order.
- Select 'Asset function' from the 'Order results by the following fields' combobox.
- Confirm the selection by pressing Enter and click 'Run filter' to apply the sort.
- Go to the task history and open the specific task record (e.g., 'Private Task, Sort the asset list...').
- Change the 'State' field to 'Closed Complete' and click 'Update' to finalize.
- Verify the task is updated and the trajectory ends.
